socket_path.description: Path to the UNIX-domain socket used for communicating with the agent. Supports random substitution with 'XXXXXX' in the path.

always_allow_idtoken.description: Always allow id-token requests without manual approval by the user.

confirm.description: Requires user confirmation when an application requests an access token for any loaded configuration.

no_autoload.description: Disables the autoload feature: A token request cannot load the needed configuration automatically.

no_auto_reauthenticate.description: Disables the automatic re-authentication feature when a refresh token expires.

no_scheme.description: Disables custom URI scheme redirect for the authorization code flow.

no_webserver.description: Disables starting a local webserver for the authorization code flow.

pw_store_timeout.description: Time in seconds to keep encryption passwords in memory. 0 or negative value means forever.

lifetime.description: Default maximum lifetime in seconds for account configurations. 0 means forever.

with_group.description: Group name allowing other users to access the agent. Set to empty string to disable.

console.description: Run oidc-agent on the console without daemonizing.

debug.description: Set the log level to DEBUG.

log_stderr.description: Additionally print log messages to stderr.
